parameters.name: wid
parameters.description: Not needed: the workspace comes from your token. If you send it, it must be your `workspace_id`.

parameters.name: networkId
parameters.description: Network filter by provider ID (e.g. ethereum, base). Values come from GET /defi/networks.

parameters.name: includeSpam
parameters.description: Not supported yet: spam marking does not apply to DeFi positions (unlike token/NFT holdings), so this parameter currently has no effect. Reserved for future position-level spam flagging.
